These are hand-authored regression responses, not live captures. `essentials-list.txt`
models EssentialsX's colored, grouped `/list` output when it shadows vanilla `/list`;
`namespaced-unsupported.txt` models an explicit Brigadier command rejection on a
server without the namespaced command. Existing captured Paper 26.3 fixtures and
MockWorld cover UUIDs, multipart/truncated lists and legacy player data. No production
server was contacted or modified for these tests.
